settings.title: Prompter settings
settings.followHint: On-device speech recognition scrolls at your pace (fully offline)
settings.stealthHint: The prompter stays invisible to screen recording, screenshots and meeting share
settings.clickThroughHint: Mouse clicks pass through the prompter; control it with shortcuts
settings.shortcutHint: Shortcuts are released when prompting ends

selftest.title: Stealth self-test
selftest.hint: The prompter window flashes once, then we report whether this machine can capture it.

result.invisible: ✅ Stealth confirmed: screen capture on this machine cannot see the prompter
result.leaked: ⚠️ The prompter was captured. If you use OBS, switch to a legacy "Window Capture" source instead of macOS Screen Capture
result.capture-unavailable: Cannot auto-test: grant this app Screen Recording permission in System Settings first
result.display-not-found: Could not match the prompter's display; test skipped
result.protection-disabled: Stealth is currently off — the prompter will be recorded
